run_save_encoder_cli: run the save_encoder CLI to extract and save encoder outputs from a fairseq model
run_get_avg_pool: run get_avg_pool to compute average pooled encoder representations for a batch of samples
run_main_extraction: run main to load a fairseq model ensemble and extract encoder outputs for a dataset
review_get_avg_pool: review get_avg_pool to understand how encoder outputs are masked and averaged across sequences
review_main_pipeline: review main to understand the full pipeline for loading models, iterating batches, and saving encoder outputs
